Mango Markets is a decentralized trading and lending platform built on the Solana blockchain. Mango Markets offers spot trading and perpetual futures trading. Mango Markets uses cross-margin accounts for its leveraged positions. Mango Markets is governed through its MNGO token. Mango Markets suffered a large exploit involving price manipulation of its oracle in October 2022.

Idle is a DeFi yield optimization protocol built on Ethereum. Idle directs user funds to lending markets such as Compound and Aave to seek the best available yield. Idle offers risk-tiered tranches to its depositors. Idle is governed by its IDLE token holders through a DAO.

1inch is a decentralized exchange aggregator that operates across multiple blockchains. 1inch routes trades across many liquidity sources to obtain better prices. 1inch offers a limit order protocol for users who set their own trade prices. 1inch is governed through its 1INCH token.

Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that supplies external data to smart contracts on public blockchains. Chainlink delivers price feeds that DeFi applications use for pricing and liquidation logic. Chainlink uses its LINK token to pay node operators and secure the network. Chainlink has developed a cross-chain interoperability protocol for transferring messages and tokens between blockchains.

Balancer is an automated market maker protocol built on Ethereum. Balancer supports liquidity pools with more than two tokens and custom token weights. Balancer uses a shared vault architecture in its V2 design. Balancer is governed through its BAL token and the vote-escrowed veBAL token.
